commands:
set -eu
POD=$(k3s kubectl get pods -n phantom -l app=phantom-ebpf-agent -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
echo AGENT_POD=$POD
echo AGENT_METRICS_BEFORE
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom "$POD" -- python3 -c "import urllib.request; t=urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:9101/metrics',timeout=3).read().decode(); print('\n'.join(x for x in t.splitlines() if 'phantom_agent_events_total{event_type=\"exec\"' in x or 'phantom_event_delivery_lag_seconds_count' in x or 'phantom_event_delivery_lag_invalid_total' in x))"
echo SMOKE_START_UTC=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)
echo HARMLESS_REAL_EXEC
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom-eval deployment/recommendationservice -- /bin/ls -ld /tmp
sleep 3
echo AGENT_METRICS_AFTER
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom "$POD" -- python3 -c "import urllib.request; t=urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:9101/metrics',timeout=3).read().decode(); print('\n'.join(x for x in t.splitlines() if 'phantom_agent_events_total{event_type=\"exec\"' in x or 'phantom_event_delivery_lag_seconds_count' in x or 'phantom_event_delivery_lag_invalid_total' in x))"
echo DATABASE_EVENT_ROWS
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom deployment/phantom-postgres -- psql -U phantom -d phantom -Atc "SELECT count(*), COALESCE(max(received_at)::text,'') FROM drift_events; SELECT event_id,event_type,identity_status,namespace,pod_name,container_name,image_digest,COALESCE(sbom_id::text,''),COALESCE(purl,''),COALESCE(binding_status,''),received_at::text FROM drift_events ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 5;"
echo REDIS_STREAM_GROUPS
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom deployment/phantom-redis -- redis-cli XLEN phantom:drift-events
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom deployment/phantom-redis -- redis-cli XINFO GROUPS phantom:drift-events 2>&1 || true
k3s kubectl exec -n phantom deployment/phantom-redis -- redis-cli XLEN phantom:dlq:graph.update
